title: Primary Murine Microglia and Neuron Co-Cultures
author: Aisha Sati
materials: Two to three days following plating in 12-well plates, treat microglia with 100 ng/mL LPS, Sigma aldrich.com Catalog #serotype 0111:B4 in DMEM, Invitrogen 10:10:1 for 24:00:00 .
Dissect cortices and midbrain from PND0-1 pups in cold HBSS Invitrogen .

After 24:00:00 , treat microglia with LPS Sigma aldrich.com Catalog #serotype 0111:B4 ( 100 ng/mL ) for 24:00:00 - Add Spd Contributed by users ( 0.3 micromolar (µM) ) for 02:00:00 - Fix in 4 % volume PFA Contributed by users AT 4 °C for 00:20:00 .

Treat microglia with Spd Contributed by users ( 0.01 micromolar (µM) and 0.3 micromolar (µM) ) in combination with pharmacological modulators, such as the polyamine transport inhibitor AMXT 1501 Contributed by users ( 1 micromolar (µM) pretreatment for 01:00:00 prior to LPS, Sigma aldrich.com Catalog #serotype 0111:B4 ), or the mitochondrial antioxidant 1 micromolar (µM) MitoTEMPO Sigma aldrich.com Catalog #SML0737 pretreatment for 01:00:00 prior to LPS. Spd Contributed by users and AMXT 1501 Contributed by users treatments are performed in combination with 1 millimolar (mM) of Aminoguanidine Contributed by users to inhibit polyamine oxidases in the sera.

- For establishing the effects of Spd treatment on neuronal cultures, treat microglia with 0.3 micromolar (µM) Spd Contributed by users for 02:00:00 - Shake at 0.42 x g, °C, 2 hours on an orbital shaker. - Resuspend microglia in 50:50 ratio of Neurobasal medium, Invitrogen and DMEM, Invitrogen 10:10:1.
Dissect the brain in DMEM, Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11965092 , and carefully remove the meninges with fine foreceps, then removing the olfactory bulb and cerebellum,

Once the tissue in homogenized, add 9 mL of DMEM 10:10:1 DMEM, Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11965092 supplemented with 10% Horse Serum Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific , 10% of FBS Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A5209501 , 1% of Penicillin/streptomycin Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P4458
Count cells with Trypan blue Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific and plate at 200,000/well in PDL-coated 12-well plates.
Microglia isolation from mixed glia cultures

- Wash coverslips with PBS two times using 500 µL/well, 5 min each. - Incubate coverslips in 1%FBS + 0.1% BSA in PBS-T using 500 µL/wellfor 1 h. - Incubate coverslips with Primary Antibody cocktail: Mix primary antibodies in 1%FBS + 0.1% BSA (determine volume based on number of wells):500 µL/well and leave overnight at 4°C. - wash coverslips with PBS two times -5 min each. -Incubate coverslips in 10% FBS + 1% BSA in PBS-Tusing 500 µL/well for 15 min at room temperature. -Incubate with secondary antibodies cocktail and Phalloidin 594 (Thermo Fisheer A12381, lot 261933) in 1%FBS + 0.1% BSA in PBS-T (determine volume based on number of wells) using 300 µL/well for 1.5 h at room temperature. - Incubate with DAPI (5ug/ml) in 1%FBS + 0.1% BSA in PBS-T (determine volume based on number of wells) using 500 µL/well for 20 min. - Wash with PBS three times, 5 min each. -Invert coverslips on glass slides using mounting media appropriate for the microscope objectives used.

steps.title: Coat Tissue Culture Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare culture plates by coating with poly-D-lysine and laminin.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL poly-D-lysine (1 mg/mL in H2O) and 1 mL laminin (0.1 mg/mL in H2O) to 28 mL H2O, mix, and add to wells.
Incubate at 37 °C for 2 hours.
Wash 3x with mqH2O.
Either add MEM and leave in incubator, or let dry and store at 4 °C (stable for at least one week).

steps.title: Coat Flasks and 12-well Plates
steps.instruction: Coat 75 cm2 flasks and 12-well plates containing round glass coverslips with poly-D-lysine.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of 5 µg/ml poly-D-lysine per flask and 500 µL per well of the 12-well plates.
Incubate at 37 °C for 2 hours.
Wash 3x with mqH2O.
Let dry after washes and store at -20 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Prepare Single Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Isolate cells from PND0-2 pup brains.

substeps.instruction: Sacrifice PND0-2 pups and wash heads with sterile PBS.
Transfer tissue to warm enzyme solution for 30 minutes in a 37 °C water bath, mixing periodically.
Wash tissue 3x with 5 mL plating media, moving tissue from one tube to the next.
Move tissue to a new tube with 1.25 mL plating media.
Triturate 3-4x using a flame-polished glass pipette (approximately half the original diameter).
Let tissue settle, remove supernatant (containing cells), add 1.25 mL plating media to remaining tissue, triturate 3-4x, let settle, and add supernatant to the existing tube and mix.
Alternatively, homogenize tissue by pipetting up and down 10-15 times using a flame-polished glass pipette (approximately half the original diameter).
Centrifuge samples at 200 x g, 21 °C for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant, add DMEM 10:10:1, resuspend, and plate single cell suspension in PDL-coated flasks.

steps.title: Isolate Microglia
steps.instruction: Separate microglia from the mixed glia layer.

substeps.instruction: Wait 10-12 days and check for microglia on top of the confluent mixed glia layer.
Shake cells at 0.42 x g for 2 hours on an orbital shaker.
Collect supernatant and spin at 200 x g, 21 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Plate and Maintain Cells
steps.instruction: Plate the isolated cells and maintain culture conditions.

substeps.instruction: Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Plate 70,000 cells/well in 12-well plates.
Maintain cells at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
After 1 hour, change media to hippocampal feeding media (HFM) and return to incubator.

steps.title: Perform Atp13a3 Knockdown
steps.instruction: Perform siRNA knockdown of Atp13a3 using DharmaFECT transfection reagent.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1 µM working stock of siRNA (Target sequences: 5’-GAAGAAAUAAGAUGCGAGA-3’, 5’-CUGCCUGAGUGGCGAGUGA-3’, 5’-GAUACUAGUGGCUUAACUUA-3’, 5’-UAUCAACAAGGGUCAAGAA-3’; Control: 5’-UGGUUUACAUGUCGACUAA-3’) using delivery media.
In eppendorf 1, mix OptiMEM and siRNA (5 nM, 10 nM, or 100 nM) to a total volume of 64 µL.
In eppendorf 2, mix 2 µL DharmaFECT transfection reagent (Horizon Discovery #T-2005-01) with Horizon delivery media to a final volume of 186 µL.
Mix eppendorf 1 and 2 (referred to as 3 in text), incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Replace media with 250 µL of the mix per well.
Incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Add microglia to neuronal cultures on DIV11 in a 1:4 ratio.
Maintain co-cultures for 72 hours at 37 °C, 5% CO2.

steps.title: Cell Harvest and Analysis
steps.instruction: Process cells for downstream analysis (ICC, qPCR, or cytokine analysis).

substeps.instruction: For co-cultures: Fix with 4% (v/v) PFA for 10 minutes on ice.
For microglia ICC: Fix in 4% (v/v) PFA for 20 minutes at 4 °C, then process for immunocytochemistry.
For qPCR: Resuspend a subset of microglia in guanidine-thiocyanate containing lysis buffer, snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80 °C.
For MitoSox detection: Treat cells with MitoSox for 35 minutes at 37 °C and 5% CO2, then image on LSM880 confocal microscope.
For cytokine analysis: Spin media supernatant at 300 x g, 4 °C for 10 minutes and store at -80 °C.
